per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  ps.name AS person_name,
  ps.position,
  ps.team,
  d.year AS draft_year,
  d.round AS draft_round,
  d.pick AS draft_pick,
  p.name AS general_manager,
  h_college.hall_of_fame_status AS college_hof,
  h_pro.hall_of_fame_status AS pro_hof
FROM 
  personnel ps
LEFT JOIN 
  draft d ON ps.name = d.player_name
LEFT JOIN 
  teams t ON ps.team = t.name
LEFT JOIN 
  general_managers gm ON t.name = gm.team AND gm.tenure_start <= d.year AND gm.tenure_end >= d.year
LEFT JOIN 
  persons p ON gm.name = p.name
LEFT JOIN 
  hall_of_fame h_college ON p.name = h_college.person_name AND h_college.hall_type = 'College Football Hall of Fame'
LEFT JOIN 
  hall_of_fame h_pro ON p.name = h_pro.person_name AND h_pro.hall_type = 'Pro Football Hall of Fame'
WHERE 
  ps.name IN ('Philip Savage', 'Steve Little')
  AND ps.position = 'Director of Player Personnel'
  AND ps.team = 'Baltimore Ravens'

ORDER BY 
  d.year;
